questions.stem: Stage one: identify verifiable note in a log. Stage two: give an unverifiable version.

options.text: verifiable 'water feels sacred'; unverifiable 'festival held in spring'
verifiable 'the spirit is pleased'; unverifiable 'festival held in spring'
verifiable 'festival held in spring'; unverifiable 'the spirit is pleased'
no verifiable note; unverifiable 'festival held in spring'

questions.explanation: Festival held in spring is verifiable; spirit pleased is not. Others reverse or misidentify.

questions.topic: Authors and works as historical fact
questions.learningObjective: Apply author fact across two stages in varied case
questions.stem: Stage one: identify historical fact about an author. Stage two: give a non-fact.

options.text: fact 'Melville hated whales'; non-fact 'Melville wrote Moby-Dick'
fact 'Melville wrote Moby-Dick'; non-fact 'Melville hated whales'
fact 'Melville never saw the ocean'; non-fact 'Melville wrote Moby-Dick'
no fact; non-fact 'Melville wrote Moby-Dick'

questions.explanation: Melville wrote Moby-Dick is fact; Melville hated whales is unsupported. Others reverse or misidentify.

questions.learningObjective: Apply register repair across two stages in varied case
questions.stem: Stage one: identify register drop in a translation. Stage two: give a formal rewrite.

options.text: drop formal to informal; rewrite 'critter checked'
rise informal to formal; rewrite 'we checked the critter'
no change; rewrite 'the critter was checked'

questions.explanation: Register drops from formal to informal; formal rewrite restores specimen examined. Others reverse, deny or stay informal.

questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.learningObjective: Identify concession in varied argument final
questions.stem: An argument says 'although recovery is slow, it does occur'. What is 'although recovery is slow'?

options.text: it is the main claim
it is a concession before the claim
it is a counterclaim
it is irrelevant detail

questions.explanation: Although recovery is slow concedes a point before asserting recovery occurs. It is not the claim, a counterclaim or irrelevant.

questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.learningObjective: Spot verifiable note in varied log final
questions.stem: Which note in a marine biologist's tank log is verifiable as cultural fact?

options.text: 'The water feels sacred' is verifiable
'The sea spirit is angry today' is verifiable
'The festival of the sea is held each spring' is verifiable
'The tide seems mystical' is verifiable

questions.explanation: A festival date is verifiable; spirit anger, sacred feeling and mystical tide are beliefs or impressions.
questions.hint: Look for a checkable date or custom.
